gateWizard.title: Create your community
gateWizard.description: Set who can join. Posting, commenting, and voting rules come later.

membership.heading: Who can join?
membership.description: Human verification applies to membership only. It never decides who can post, comment, or vote.
membership.humansOnlyDescription: Members verify they are human before they join.
membership.humansAndBotsDescription: No human verification is required to join.

invite.heading: Do members need an invitation?
invite.description: An invitation requirement combines with the membership checks.

checks.heading: Which checks should members pass?
checks.description: Members must pass every check you select. There is no either/or logic here.
checks.noneSelected: No checks selected. Anyone who passes the steps above can join.
checks.engagementNote: Who can engage — posting, commenting, and voting — is a separate setting after creation.

capability.exploration: Exploration — not backed by api-next yet

age18.label: Adults only (18+)
age18.description: Members must be at least 18 years old.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.description: Members prove a document from a country you allow.

gender.label: Document gender marker
gender.description: Members prove a document with a marker you allow.

nft.label: NFT
nft.description: Members own an NFT collection or a specific collectible.

token_balance.label: Token balance
token_balance.description: Members hold a minimum balance of an asset.

passport_score.label: Passport score
passport_score.description: Members meet a Gitcoin Passport score threshold.

nft.heading: NFT requirement
nft.contractError: Enter a mainnet contract address starting with 0x.
nft.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. a player, character, or brand

tokenBalance.heading: Which asset, and how much?
tokenBalance.assetError: Enter an asset id like eip155:1/erc20:0x…
tokenBalance.amountError: Enter an amount greater than zero.

passportScore.heading: Minimum score?
passportScore.label: Minimum Gitcoin Passport score
passportScore.error: Enter a whole score from 0 to 100.

review.heading: Ready to create your community?
review.description: Here’s what people will need to join.
review.allRequirementsNote: Everyone must meet every check you selected.
review.noChecksNote: No extra checks selected. People can join based on the choices above.
review.engagementNotice: Posting, commenting, and voting settings are separate.

requirements.reputationScore: Gitcoin Passport score of {score} or more
